Flight Operations

UAV Operator

Kfar Yona, Israel

Full-time

About the Role

We're looking for a UAV Operator to join our  flight operations team. You'll operate the Cargo 1200 through its full mission cycle - pre-flight through post-flight — from our proprietary ground control station, supporting both flight-test campaigns, engineering, integration and operational missions.

‍

Key Responsibilities

Operate the Genie Cargo 1200 via AIR's ground control station across test and operational flights -  Monitor telemetry, datalink health, and aircraft systems in real time; execute emergency procedures per QRH
Write and Execute pre-flight checklists, mission planning, in-flight monitoring, and post-flight reporting
Work hand-in-hand with R&Dt engineers to run structured test cards and capture data
Contribute to procedure refinement - shape our checklists, SOPs, and GCS design
Support simulator sessions for rehearsal, training, and fault-injection scenarios
Integrate, build and hands-on work on our test-bed drones, HIL, Ironbird and actual aircrafts.

‍

Requirements

Must Have

Proven UAV operation experience (military or civilian) - multirotor, VTOL, or fixed-wing UAS
Strong systems understanding: datalinks, GNSS, batteries/propulsion, flight modes, failure management
Cool head under pressure - you follow procedure when it matters and know when to escalate
Fluent English (technical documentation, checklists)
Willingness to work flexible hours around flight windows and weather

‍

Advantages

Technical training or engineering degree (not a must)
Experience on cargo/logistics UAS or eVTOL platforms
Flight test experience (test cards, telemetry review, anomaly reporting) CAAI familiarity / UAV operator certification
Instruction or mentoring background

‍

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to be part of a pioneering company developing next-generation electric aircraft.
  • A dynamic, innovative, and fast-growing startup environment.
  • Collaboration with leading aerospace and automotive partners worldwide.
  • Professional growth within multidisciplinary engineering and operational teams.
  • Hybrid work opportunities (where applicable).
  • Equal opportunity employment – we welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

Engineering & R&D

Senior System Engineer

Kfar Yona, Israel

Full-time

About the Role

AIR is seeking a Senior System Engineer to lead aircraft-level system engineering activities across the complete development lifecycle of unmanned and autonomous aircraft.

The role requires a broad technical perspective, strong problem-solving capabilities, and a hands-on approach to system integration and debugging. The engineer will work closely with all engineering disciplines, including mechanical, hardware, software, avionics, flight science, power train and flight-test teams.

This position is suited to an experienced system engineer who can translate operational and business needs into clear system requirements, define aircraft-level architecture, manage interfaces, and drive complex technical issues through integration, verification, and flight testing.

‍

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead aircraft-level system engineering activities from concept definition through development, integration, verification, flight testing, and operational support.
  • Define and maintain aircraft-level requirements, system architecture, interfaces, and verification methods.
  • Translate operational and product needs and high-level objectives into clear, testable technical requirements.
  • Coordinate technical activities across multiple engineering teams.
  • Lead system verification and validation including integration activities, ground and flight-test campaigns.
  • Investigate and resolve complex multidisciplinary technical issues using structured problem-solving and root-cause analysis.
  • Perform hands-on debugging of integrated aircraft systems, including hardware, software and avionics.
  • Manage system interfaces and ensure compatibility between aircraft subsystems.
  • Support system safety, reliability, risk assessment, and requirements traceability activities.
  • Participate in design reviews, readiness reviews, failure investigations, and technical decision-making.
  • Work with suppliers and external partners on system requirements, interfaces, integration, and qualification.
  • Support compliance and certification activities throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Identify technical risks, system gaps, and integration challenges, and drive them to closure.
  • Maintain clear and structured system engineering documentation.

‍

Requirements

Must Have

  • B.Sc. in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • At least five years of relevant experience in system engineering, aircraft development, unmanned systems, autonomous systems, or other complex multidisciplinary products.
  • Experience working across the complete product development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience with system integration, troubleshooting, and debugging.
  • Ability to analyze complex multidisciplinary problems and lead effective technical resolution.
  • Experience defining system requirements, architectures, interfaces, and verification activities.
  • Strong understanding of interactions between hardware, software, mechanical systems, avionics, sensors and control systems.
  • Ability to work effectively with multiple engineering teams and technical disciplines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take technical ownership, and operate effectively in a fast-paced development environment.

‍

Advantages

  • Experience with model-based systems engineering, SysML, or MBSE tools and methodologies.
  • M Sc. in Systems Engineering.
  • Practical experience with aviation development and certification standards, including ARP4754A, ARP4761, DO-178C, DO-254, DO-160, ASTM standards, or equivalent.
  • Experience with safety-critical or mission-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with requirements-management, configuration-management, simulation, or data-analysis tools.
  • Experience working with aviation authorities, certification organizations, or aerospace suppliers.

‍

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to be part of a pioneering company developing next-generation electric aircraft.
  • A dynamic, innovative, and fast-growing startup environment.
  • Collaboration with leading aerospace and automotive partners worldwide.
  • Professional growth within multidisciplinary engineering and operational teams.
  • Hybrid work opportunities (where applicable).
  • Equal opportunity employment – we welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

‍

Flight Control Engineer

Kfar Yona, Israel

Full-time

About the Role

AIR is looking for a talented Flight Control Engineer to join our Flight Sciences team. In this role, you will develop, simulate, validate, and optimize advanced flight control systems for our next-generation electric aircraft while working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop flight control algorithms and system architectures.
  • Develop and maintain MATLAB/Simulink models.
  • Build, analyze, and validate dynamic aircraft simulations.
  • Support system integration, verification, and validation activities.
  • Collaborate with aerodynamics, software, hardware, and systems engineering teams.
  • Participate in flight test preparation and performance analysis.
  • Improve flight control performance through simulation and testing.

Requirements

Must Have

  • B.Sc. in Aerospace Engineering.
  • 4–6 years of relevant industry experience.
  • Strong proficiency with MATLAB and Simulink.
  • Knowledge of flight dynamics and control systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work within multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Advantages

  • Aerospace industry experience.
  • Experience with VTOL or eVTOL platforms.
  • Experience with large UAV systems.
  • Knowledge of code generation tools.
  • Experience developing and validating 6-DOF simulations.

About the Role

AIR is looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, and validation of the aircraft's electrical power and electronic systems. This role combines hands-on engineering with system-level leadership and close collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.

‍

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design of high-voltage (up to 800V) and low-voltage electrical systems.
  • Design and develop aircraft wiring harnesses and electrical architectures.
  • Lead system manufacturing, integration, and validation activities.
  • Collaborate with avionics, propulsion, software, and mechanical engineering teams.
  • Support testing, troubleshooting, and system optimization.

  • Develop creative engineering solutions for complex technical challenges.

Must Have

  • B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in electrical or hardware engineering.
  • Proven experience leading complex electrical system development.
  • Strong knowledge of High Voltage and Low Voltage electrical systems.
  • Experience with electric powertrains, motor controllers, and Battery Management Systems (BMS).
  • Experience with system integration, validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience using AI tools and LLMs to improve engineering workflows.
  • Programming or scripting experience (Python is an advantage).
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
